neighbours.label: Electric current as a quantity: ' current' in the electrical sense and the amp unit 'A' after a number; not the temporal or water sense of 'current'
fire: A thicker wire is needed because the heater draws a large current at startup.
The adapter supplies 12V DC at 3A through a barrel connector.
A fuse melts when the current through it exceeds its rating.
The meter can measure voltage, current and resistance on the same dial.
Each USB port is limited to 5V and 2A by the controller.
The battery pack can deliver enough current to start a small engine.
In a series circuit the same current passes through every lamp.
The LED driver holds the output current constant as the supply changes.
quiet: A thicker wall is needed because the heater reaches a high temperature at startup.
The adapter is 12 cm long and connects through a barrel connector.
A fuse is replaced when the current owner of the house asks for it.
The meter can measure voltage, temperature and humidity on the same dial.
Each USB port is checked by the current version of the controller.
The battery pack is heavy enough to hold a small door open.
In the current series the same actor appears in every episode.
The swimmer fought the current of the river as the tide changed.

notes: Card: ' current' x8 (electrical), 'A' in '5V 1A', then ' flow', ' volume', ' power'; the + pole has voltage / height and its output promotes ' height'. Probes: draw more current 0.61, '2A' 0.72, 'resistance, current' 0.38, flow of water 0.28; 'current president / current events' 0.01, river's current 0.01, voltage sentence 0.04. Flow-like quantities fire weakly, so the wider reading may be 'amount flowing' against the + pole's 'level / potential'; this test claims only the electrical case.
